small_guidance:
- Add a `triton.autotune` over (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_HW, BLOCK_IC, num_warps, num_stages): try BLOCK_OC∈{32,64,128}, BLOCK_HW∈{64,128,256}, BLOCK_IC∈{16,32,64}, num_warps∈{4,8}, num_stages∈{2,3,4}. Current 64×128×32 is unlikely optimal for OC=128, OH·OW≈264k.
- Replace `tl.atomic_add` into pooled (N·OC) with a per-(N, OC, hw_tile) partial buffer + a second small kernel that sums + adds bias + does logsumexp; atomics across ~2000 hw-tiles per (n,oc) serialize writes. Alternatively make one program own the entire HW axis per (n, oc-tile) and accumulate in registers (BLOCK_HW loop), eliminating atomics entirely.
- Hoist the input-channel loop outside the (kh, kw) loops so x is loaded once per ic tile and reused across the 9 kernel taps; current ordering reloads x 9× per ic block.
large_guidance:
- Redesign as a direct (non-im2col) ConvTranspose2d → mean fusion where each program owns one (n, oc_tile) and streams the full OH×OW grid, accumulating the spatial sum directly into a register scalar per oc (size BLOCK_OC). Output is just (N, OC) — no atomics, no pooled materialization across hw-tiles. The mean reduction collapses HW inside the kernel so global memory traffic for the conv output is zero.
- Since stride=1, padding=0, kernel=3, the conv-transpose is mostly a "same-conv with full padding" pattern: for each (oh, ow) the valid (kh, kw, ih, iw) set is small. Iterate the outer loop over input positions (ih, iw, ic) and scatter-add the 3×3 contribution into a per-oc spatial accumulator — but since we only need Σ over HW, accumulate `Σ_{ih,iw} x[n,ic,ih,iw] * Σ_{kh,kw}` per oc would be the shortcut (forbidden). Instead, keep per-(oh,ow) work but fuse into one persistent kernel per (n, oc_tile) that walks HW tiles and reduces in-register.
- Fuse bias-add + logsumexp + ×10 into the same final kernel reading the per-(n,oc) sums from registers/SMEM if you make one program cover all OC for a given n; with OC=128 that fits easily in one block (BLOCK_OC=128, one warp-reduce for LSE), removing the second kernel launch entirely.
